scientific_integrity: The finite signed error bound and exact asymptotic total-variation coefficient have complete analytical proofs; exact small enumeration and numeric checks are supplemental. Historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Uniform equal-size independent groups, fixed number of rounds, and bounded-intensity regime for useful asymptotics; signed correction is not a probability law; possible unindexed historical coverage by general expansion theory.
title: Sharp Poisson–Charlier correction for nearly complete group coupon drawings
